title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
abstract: arXiv:2611.06911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, app

translated_title: BEAKER：自动驾驶化学实验室中具身大脑的专家策划基准
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶化学实验室正在推动化学实验迈向具身自动化，在此过程中，机器必须感知实验室场景、推理实验状态，并在物理、程序和安全约束下执行操作。尽管多模态大语言模型越来越多地被视为此类系统的具身大脑，但现有的实验室基准主要关注安全性、异常检测或通用科学理解，其面向执行的具身能力仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BEAKER，一个用于评估自动驾驶化学实验室中具身可操作性、知识、实验与推理能力的基准。BEAKER包含1,000个由专家策划的问答样本，涵盖11种图像和视频任务类型，覆盖化学实验室执行所需的关键判断，包括可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备、状态与安全识别等……
tldr: 该论文提出了BEAKER——一个由专家策划、包含1,000个问答样本和11种图像与视频任务的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶化学实验室中面向执行的具身推理与操作能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BEAKER, an expert-curated benchmark with 1,000 QA samples across 11 image and video task types to evaluate the execution-oriented embodied capabilities of MLLMs as embodied brains in self-driving chemical laboratories.
